securityAudits.test: ZIP Slip Path Traversal Attack (../ and / escapes)
securityAudits.mechanism: readZipBuffer explicitly detects '..', leading '/', and leading '\', throwing 'Security Violation: Illegal path traversal detected' before unpacking.
readZipBuffer tracks seen file paths with Set<string> and throws 'Security Violation: Duplicate archive entry path detected' to prevent shadow overwrites.

securityAudits.payload: Corrupted compressed payload byte in central directory stream
securityAudits.mechanism: Pure TypeScript IEEE 802.3 CRC32 verifier validates uncompressed bytes against 32-bit header checksum; rejects corrupted files.

securityAudits.payload: Modified document content inside subjects.json after manifest compilation
securityAudits.mechanism: verifyZipIntegrity recalculates SHA-256 hash for every file and compares against reports/integrity_manifest.json; restore aborts on any mismatch.
File lock backups/.restore_active.lock enforces single restore at a time; secondary attempt rejected with 409 Conflict.

securityAudits.payload: Admin deletion of stored ZIP archive from disk
securityAudits.mechanism: deleteStoredBackup uses path.basename to prevent path traversal and unlinks only the local ZIP file in backups/; zero writes or deletes sent to Firestore.

securityAudits.payload: Unauthenticated or non-admin HTTP request to /api/admin/backup/*
securityAudits.mechanism: requireVerifiedAdmin middleware validates Firebase Auth ID token and admin claims/whitelist; unauthorized requests rejected with 401/403.
